standard.note: Va. Code 40.1-28.10, now on annual CPI adjustment ($12.41 in 2025). 2027: $13.75 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: Virginia keeps the federal $2.13 cash wage, so its tip credit is the difference up to $12.77.

youthAndTraining.label: Federal youth opportunity wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 consecutive calendar days -- 29 U.S.C. 206(g). Not a state figure; carried here because it is the only sub-minimum wage available in this state.

sources.title: Code of Virginia 40.1-28.10 -- Minimum wages
sources.verifiedBy: Search result from law.lis.virginia.gov: 'From January 1, 2027, until January 1, 2028, every employer shall pay to each of its employees wages at a rate not less than the greater of (i) $13.75 per hour'. $15.00 follows on 2028-01-01.
